mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) as totalSales, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as originalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount), 0) as totalDiscount, COUNT(*) as orderCount, COALESCE(AVG(actual_amount), 0) as avgOrderAmount FROM restaurant_order WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND payment_status IN (1, 2) AND status != 6 AND payment_time >= #{startTime} AND payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND)

SELECT DATE(ro.payment_time) as date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN roi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) as salesQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 AND oit.itemPayableAmount > 0 THEN roi.line_payable_amount * ro.actual_amount / oit.itemPayableAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) as salesAmount FROM restaurant_order_item roi INNER JOIN restaurant_order ro ON roi.order_id = ro.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, order_id, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN line_payable_amount ELSE 0 END) AS itemPayableAmount FROM restaurant_order_item GROUP BY tenant_id, order_id ) oit ON oit.tenant_id = ro.tenant_id AND oit.order_id = ro.id WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId} AND roi.dish_id = #{dishId} AND ro.payment_status IN (1, 2) AND ro.status != 6 AND ro.payment_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND ro.payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(ro.payment_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT odl.dish_id as dishId, COALESCE(d.dish_name, CONCAT('菜品#', odl.dish_id)) as dishName, odl.category_id as categoryId, COALESCE(dc.category_name, '未分类') as categoryName, #{changeType} as changeType,
COALESCE(odl.reason, '未填写原因') NULL as reason, COUNT(DISTINCT odl.order_id) as orderCount, COUNT(*) as changeCount, COALESCE(SUM(odl.quantity), 0) as quantity, COALESCE(SUM(odl.amount), 0) as amount FROM order_dish_change_log odl LEFT JOIN dish d ON odl.dish_id = d.id LEFT JOIN dish_category dc ON odl.category_id = dc.id WHERE odl.store_id = #{storeId} AND odl.change_type = #{changeType} AND odl.occurred_at >= #{startTime} AND odl.occurred_at < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) GROUP BY odl.dish_id, d.dish_name, odl.category_id, dc.category_name
, COALESCE(odl.reason, '未填写原因')
ORDER BY quantity DESC, amount DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(payment_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) as sales, COUNT(*) as orderCount, COALESCE(AVG(actual_amount), 0) as avgOrderAmount FROM restaurant_order WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND payment_status IN (1, 2) AND status != 6 AND payment_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(payment_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT period_type, CASE period_type WHEN 1 THEN '早餐' WHEN 2 THEN '午餐' WHEN 3 THEN '下午茶' WHEN 4 THEN '晚餐' ELSE '夜宵' END as periodName, CASE period_type WHEN 1 THEN '06:00-10:00' WHEN 2 THEN '10:00-14:00' WHEN 3 THEN '14:00-17:00' WHEN 4 THEN '17:00-21:00' ELSE '21:00-06:00' END as timeRange, sales, orderCount FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN HOUR(payment_time) >= 6 AND HOUR(payment_time) < 10 THEN 1 WHEN HOUR(payment_time) >= 10 AND HOUR(payment_time) < 14 THEN 2 WHEN HOUR(payment_time) >= 14 AND HOUR(payment_time) < 17 THEN 3 WHEN HOUR(payment_time) >= 17 AND HOUR(payment_time) < 21 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END as period_type, COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) as sales, COUNT(*) as orderCount FROM restaurant_order WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND payment_status IN (1, 2) AND status != 6 AND payment_time >= #{startTime} AND payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) GROUP BY CASE WHEN HOUR(payment_time) >= 6 AND HOUR(payment_time) < 10 THEN 1 WHEN HOUR(payment_time) >= 10 AND HOUR(payment_time) < 14 THEN 2 WHEN HOUR(payment_time) >= 14 AND HOUR(payment_time) < 17 THEN 3 WHEN HOUR(payment_time) >= 17 AND HOUR(payment_time) < 21 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ) t ORDER BY period_type

SELECT COALESCE(cancel_reason, '未填写原因') as cancelReason, COUNT(*) as cancelCount FROM restaurant_order WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND status = 6 AND cancel_time >= #{startTime} AND cancel_time < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) GROUP BY cancel_reason ORDER BY cancelCount DESC

SELECT cohort.totalOrderCount, cohort.completedOrderCount, cohort.cancelledOrderCount, cohort.processingOrderCount, finance.totalSales, finance.totalDiscount, finance.avgOrderAmount FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) as totalOrderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedOrderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cancelledOrderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as processingOrderCount FROM restaurant_order WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) ) cohort CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) as totalSales, COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount), 0) as totalDiscount, COALESCE(AVG(actual_amount), 0) as avgOrderAmount FROM restaurant_order WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND payment_status IN (1, 2) AND status != 6 AND payment_time >= #{startTime} AND payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) ) finance

SELECT roi.dish_id as dishId, d.dish_name as dishName, roi.category_id as categoryId, dc.category_name as categoryName, d.dish_pics as dishPic, COALESCE(sd.stock, d.stock) as stock, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN roi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) as salesQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 AND oit.itemPayableAmount > 0 THEN roi.line_payable_amount * ro.actual_amount / oit.itemPayableAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) as salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN roi.is_gift = 1 THEN roi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) as giftQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN roi.unit_list_price * roi.quantity - CASE WHEN oit.itemPayableAmount > 0 THEN roi.line_payable_amount * ro.actual_amount / oit.itemPayableAmount ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalDiscount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN ro.id END) as orderCount FROM restaurant_order_item roi INNER JOIN restaurant_order ro ON roi.order_id = ro.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, order_id, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN line_payable_amount ELSE 0 END) AS itemPayableAmount FROM restaurant_order_item GROUP BY tenant_id, order_id ) oit ON oit.tenant_id = ro.tenant_id AND oit.order_id = ro.id LEFT JOIN dish d ON roi.dish_id = d.id LEFT JOIN dish_category dc ON roi.category_id = dc.id LEFT JOIN store_dish sd ON sd.store_id = ro.store_id AND sd.dish_id = roi.dish_id AND sd.deleted = 0 WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId} AND ro.payment_status IN (1, 2) AND ro.status != 6 AND ro.payment_time >= #{startTime} AND ro.payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) GROUP BY roi.dish_id, d.dish_name, roi.category_id, dc.category_name, d.dish_pics, sd.stock, d.stock HAVING salesQuantity > 0 ORDER BY salesQuantity DESC, salesAmount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id as dishId, d.dish_name as dishName, dc.category_name as categoryName, d.dish_pics as dishPic, COALESCE(sd.stock, d.stock) as stock, d.created_at as createdAt, COALESCE(period_sales.salesQuantity, 0) as salesLast30Days, COALESCE(period_sales.salesAmount, 0) as salesAmountLast30Days, last_sale.lastSaleTime as lastSaleTime FROM dish d LEFT JOIN store_dish sd ON sd.store_id = #{storeId} AND sd.dish_id = d.id AND sd.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN dish_category dc ON COALESCE(sd.category_override_id, d.category_id) = dc.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT roi1.dish_id, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi1.is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN roi1.quantity ELSE 0 END) as salesQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi1.is_gift, 0) = 0 AND oit1.itemPayableAmount > 0 THEN roi1.line_payable_amount * ro1.actual_amount / oit1.itemPayableAmount ELSE 0 END) as salesAmount FROM restaurant_order_item roi1 INNER JOIN restaurant_order ro1 ON roi1.order_id = ro1.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, order_id, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN line_payable_amount ELSE 0 END) AS itemPayableAmount FROM restaurant_order_item GROUP BY tenant_id, order_id ) oit1 ON oit1.tenant_id = ro1.tenant_id AND oit1.order_id = ro1.id WHERE ro1.store_id = #{storeId} AND ro1.payment_status IN (1, 2) AND ro1.status != 6 AND ro1.payment_time >= #{startTime} AND ro1.payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) GROUP BY roi1.dish_id ) period_sales ON period_sales.dish_id = d.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT roi2.dish_id, MAX(ro2.payment_time) as lastSaleTime FROM restaurant_order_item roi2 INNER JOIN restaurant_order ro2 ON roi2.order_id = ro2.id WHERE ro2.store_id = #{storeId} AND ro2.payment_status IN (1, 2) AND ro2.status != 6 AND COALESCE(roi2.is_gift, 0) = 0 AND ro2.payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) GROUP BY roi2.dish_id ) last_sale ON last_sale.dish_id = d.id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.master_status != 2 AND ((sd.id IS NOT NULL AND sd.listing_status = 1) OR (sd.id IS NULL AND d.store_id = #{storeId} AND d.sale_status = 1)) ORDER BY salesLast30Days ASC, salesAmountLast30Days ASC

SELECT roi.category_id as categoryId, COALESCE(dc.category_name, '未分类') as categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN roi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) as salesQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 AND oit.itemPayableAmount > 0 THEN roi.line_payable_amount * ro.actual_amount / oit.itemPayableAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) as salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN roi.is_gift = 1 THEN roi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) as giftQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN roi.unit_list_price * roi.quantity - CASE WHEN oit.itemPayableAmount > 0 THEN roi.line_payable_amount * ro.actual_amount / oit.itemPayableAmount ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalDiscount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN ro.id END) as orderCount FROM restaurant_order_item roi INNER JOIN restaurant_order ro ON roi.order_id = ro.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, order_id, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN line_payable_amount ELSE 0 END) AS itemPayableAmount FROM restaurant_order_item GROUP BY tenant_id, order_id ) oit ON oit.tenant_id = ro.tenant_id AND oit.order_id = ro.id LEFT JOIN dish_category dc ON roi.category_id = dc.id WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId} AND ro.payment_status IN (1, 2) AND ro.status != 6 AND ro.payment_time >= #{startTime} AND ro.payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) GROUP BY roi.category_id, dc.category_name HAVING salesQuantity > 0 ORDER BY salesAmount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 AND oit.itemPayableAmount > 0 THEN roi.line_payable_amount * ro.actual_amount / oit.itemPayableAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM restaurant_order_item roi INNER JOIN restaurant_order ro ON roi.order_id = ro.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, order_id, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN line_payable_amount ELSE 0 END) AS itemPayableAmount FROM restaurant_order_item GROUP BY tenant_id, order_id ) oit ON oit.tenant_id = ro.tenant_id AND oit.order_id = ro.id WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId} AND ro.payment_status IN (1, 2) AND ro.status != 6 AND ro.payment_time >= #{startTime} AND ro.payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(roi.is_gift, 0) = 0 THEN roi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM restaurant_order_item roi INNER JOIN restaurant_order ro ON roi.order_id = ro.id WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId} AND ro.payment_status IN (1, 2) AND ro.status != 6 AND ro.payment_time >= #{startTime} AND ro.payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS knownMembers, COALESCE(SUM(member_orders >= 2), 0) AS repeatMembers, COALESCE(SUM(last_order_at >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59'), INTERVAL 30 DAY)), 0) AS activeMembers, COALESCE(SUM(last_order_at < DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59'), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND last_order_at >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59'), INTERVAL 90 DAY)), 0) AS dormantMembers, COALESCE(AVG(member_orders), 0) AS averageOrdersPerMember, COALESCE(SUM(member_sales), 0) AS memberSales FROM ( SELECT ro.user_id, COUNT(*) AS member_orders, MAX(ro.payment_time) AS last_order_at, SUM(ro.actual_amount) AS member_sales FROM restaurant_order ro WHERE ro.user_id IS NOT NULL AND ro.payment_status IN (1, 2) AND ro.status != 6 AND ro.payment_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND ro.payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND ro.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY ro.user_id ) members

SELECT ro.order_type AS channelCode, CASE ro.order_type WHEN 0 THEN '在线点餐' WHEN 1 THEN '堂食/预点' WHEN 2 THEN '门店自提' ELSE '其他' END AS channelName, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(ro.actual_amount), 0) AS sales, COALESCE(AVG(ro.actual_amount), 0) AS averageOrderAmount FROM restaurant_order ro WHERE ro.payment_status IN (1, 2) AND ro.status != 6 AND ro.payment_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND ro.payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND ro.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY ro.order_type ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT sd.store_id AS storeId, s.store_name AS storeName, sd.dish_id AS dishId, d.dish_name AS dishName, sd.stock, sd.sold_out AS soldOut, sd.sales_count AS cumulativeSales FROM store_dish sd INNER JOIN store_info s ON s.id = sd.store_id INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = sd.dish_id WHERE sd.deleted = 0 AND sd.inventory_mode = 1 AND sd.listing_status = 1 AND (sd.stock <= #{lowStock} OR sd.sold_out = 1) AND sd.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY sd.sold_out DESC, sd.stock ASC, sd.sales_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS completedSessions, COALESCE(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, ts.start_time, ts.end_time)), 0) AS averageDiningMinutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.table_id) AS activeTables, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ts.table_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT ts.table_id) END AS turnoverPerActiveTable FROM table_session ts WHERE ts.status = 2 AND ts.end_time IS NOT NULL AND ts.start_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND ts.start_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND ts.store_id = #{storeId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS paidOrders, COALESCE(SUM(ro.actual_amount), 0) AS sales, COALESCE(SUM(ro.discount_amount), 0) AS discountCost, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ro.discount_amount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS discountedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ro.user_coupon_ids IS NOT NULL AND ro.user_coupon_ids != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS couponOrders, CASE WHEN SUM(ro.actual_amount) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(ro.discount_amount) / SUM(ro.actual_amount) * 100 END AS discountCostRate FROM restaurant_order ro WHERE ro.payment_status IN (1, 2) AND ro.status != 6 AND ro.payment_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND ro.payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND ro.store_id = #{storeId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(odl.quantity), 0) AS returnedDishQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(odl.amount), 0) AS returnedDishAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT odl.order_id) AS affectedOrders FROM order_dish_change_log odl WHERE odl.change_type = 2 AND odl.occurred_at >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND odl.occurred_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND odl.store_id = #{storeId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS createdOrders, COALESCE(SUM(ro.status = 6), 0) AS cancelledOrders, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(ro.status = 6) / COUNT(*) * 100 END AS cancelRate FROM restaurant_order ro WHERE ro.created_at >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND ro.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND ro.store_id = #{storeId}
